item.text: To book the room, first submit the dates and times you would like to use it. The booking team will then check whether the room is available during that period. You will receive a message confirming that your request was received. However, this message does not mean your booking has been approved. Your reservation is only confirmed after the team has completed its review and sent you an approval.
